tools.name: list_games
tools.description: Find public games to recommend by name, keyword, or genre. Returns game summaries, player counts, availability, and website links, plus the number of matching games. Check status before sending someone to play.

tools.name: get_rankings
tools.description: Read up to 20 results per list for most-played games, most-loved games, most-active players, and highest-scoring players. Pass an empty object. Practice scores come from clients and use different scales across games.

tools.name: get_documentation
tools.description: Look up published Tailor Game guidance before describing features, access, pricing, game availability, or integration behavior. Returns the selected topic, its canonical source URL, and the full Markdown guide.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_games" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search the public game catalog and inspect playable or coming-soon status. No account, private games, or credentials are accessed." → after: "Find public games to recommend by name, keyword, or genre. Returns game summaries, player counts, availability, and website links, plus the number of matching games. Check status before sending someone to play."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
